releases.name: v0.30.4
releases.notes:
- Restored native browser time pickers on the Schedule page while retaining the saved 12/24-hour preference.
- Made the synchronized local time tick continuously and periodically correct itself from the ESP32 clock.
- Highlighted time-based brightness, quiet hours, and nighttime shutoff rules while each is active.

releases.name: v0.30.3
releases.notes:
- Changed public OTA staging to retain only the current firmware binary and release-notes file in repository snapshots and generated source archives.
- Preserved historical firmware binaries as assets on their corresponding GitHub release pages.

releases.name: v0.30.2
releases.notes: - Registered the Schedule page as a direct HTTP route so browser refreshes and bookmarked `/schedule` links return the embedded UI instead of a JSON 404.

releases.name: v0.30.1
releases.notes:
- Replaced the technical POSIX timezone field with a worldwide country/capital selector while retaining embedded daylight-saving rules.
- Added a saved 12/24-hour display preference and consistent schedule-time dropdown labels.

releases.name: v0.30.0
releases.notes:
- Added an NTP-backed Schedule page with configurable POSIX timezone and daylight-saving support.
- Added time-based brightness and quiet-hours illumination caps with overnight-range support.
- Added an optional nighttime LED shutoff that overrides other brightness controls.
- Kept NTP disabled unless at least one time-based feature is enabled, and used normal brightness until synchronization succeeds.

releases.name: v0.29.1
releases.notes: - Simplified the introductory text for community colour presets.

releases.name: v0.29.0
releases.notes:
- Added ISO publication timestamps to community preset documents and catalogue entries.
- Added persistent preset sorting by name, newest first, or oldest first in the Colors page.
- Displayed each preset's localized publication date and verified timestamp identity when loading it.
- Migrated existing public presets with deterministic timestamps.

releases.name: v0.28.0
releases.notes:
- Replaced GitHub-account-dependent colour preset submissions with an anonymous, rate-limited Cloudflare Worker API.
- Added a free-text description to community presets and migrated individual preset documents to schema 2 and the catalogue to schema 3.
- Added a stable pseudonymous hardware ID derived from the ESP32 eFuse without publishing its raw identity.
- Highlighted presets submitted by the current lightbar as **Your preset**.
- Added strict Worker-side validation, bounded request sizes, integrity hashes, a D1 submission queue, and a scheduled GitHub catalogue publisher authenticated with short-lived Actions OIDC.

releases.name: v0.27.0
releases.notes:
- Moved Effect priority under Show advanced.
- Replaced the monolithic preset catalogue with a bounded index and one independently loadable file per preset.
- Added 64 KiB index and 4 KiB preset limits, a 200-preset cap, request timeouts, strict client-side schema/range/path/duplicate validation, and SHA-256 integrity verification before applying downloaded colours.
- Serialized preset publication and made each preset/index update an atomic Git commit.
- Pinned the GitHub publishing Action to an immutable commit.

releases.name: v0.26.0
releases.notes:
- Added built-in and community colour presets to the Colors page, including one-click loading of the original Seeq defaults.
- Added GitHub preset submission without storing write credentials on the lightbar.
- Added strict preset schema/name validation, blocked-term checks, and duplicate rejection before automatic catalogue publication.
- Published the live preset catalogue and automatic submission workflow through the public OTA/release repository.

releases.name: v0.25.0
releases.notes:
- Added a three-second BOOT-button long press to restart the controller.
- Preserved the existing short-press action that enables the web UI.

releases.name: v0.24.0
releases.notes:
- Added an optional printer-inactivity power-save mode with configurable delay and reduced illumination level.
- Power saving is limited to IDLE, READY, and FINISHED; printing, thermal activity, Z movement, demo/setup mode, or a disconnected printer resets the timer.
- Documented why a charge-only USB power source cannot identify an XPM52C and the recommended dedicated 24 V sense input for future hardware.

releases.name: v0.23.0
releases.notes:
- Changed GitHub release discovery to fetch and filter bounded five-release pages, avoiding the 68 KB monolithic response buffer that caused `EmptyInput` failures.
- Styled the disabled Save button with an opaque light-gray state instead of dimming it.

releases.name: v0.22.0
releases.notes:
- Switched Arduino CLI, Arduino IDE, PlatformIO, CI, and release builds to the 4 MB Minimal SPIFFS partition scheme.
- Increased each OTA application slot from 1.25 MB to approximately 1.9 MB while retaining dual-slot OTA updates.
- Documented the one-time USB partition-table migration for existing controllers.

releases.name: v0.21.0
releases.notes:
- Fixed the v0.20.0 UI initialization error that prevented the PrusaLink Test button and dirty-state Save behavior from loading.
- Added changelog-derived notes to private and public GitHub releases.
- Limited the firmware list viewport to five collapsed rows while retaining a scrollable history.
- Added expandable release notes to every firmware-version row.

releases.name: v0.20.0
releases.notes:
- Enabled Save only while the form differs from the loaded or last-saved configuration.
- Added hover and pressed styling for buttons and navigation tabs.
- Added an authenticated PrusaLink host/API-key connectivity test with printer-state feedback.

releases.name: v0.19.0
releases.notes:
- Added streamed one-click firmware-install progress, restart feedback, automatic reconnect detection, and UI refresh.
- Hid beta releases and beta-channel selection unless Show advanced is enabled.
- Moved Idle animation into its own advanced category.
- Aligned the firmware version with the title and the page Save action with the navigation bar.

releases.name: v0.18.0
releases.notes:
- Added optional Solid, Breathe, Soft wave, and Subtle sparkle IDLE effects.
- Swapped the PrusaLink host/IP and API-key field positions.
- Added Seeq branding to the web UI title.
- Classified strip type, white-channel contribution, and beta update selection as advanced settings.

releases.name: v0.17.0
releases.notes:
- Moved anonymous OTA discovery and downloads to the public binary-only `prusa-core-one-plus-lightbar-releases` repository.
- Added dual release publication for the transition to a private source repository.

releases.name: v0.16.0
releases.notes:
- Added a browser-persisted Show advanced toggle across the web UI.
- Hid low-frequency technical controls by default, including radio tuning, mDNS, OTA credentials/manual upload, web-UI lockout, polling, and separately-powered disconnect behavior.

releases.name: v0.15.1
releases.notes: - Replaced the separate strip auto-detection checkbox with a mutually exclusive Auto-detect option in the strip-type dropdown.

releases.name: v0.15.0
releases.notes:
- Made the detected LED count a read-only text value on the Light strip page.
- Added hardware count-ID profiles for 14-LED (72 LEDs/m) and 23-LED (120 LEDs/m) assemblies.
- Grouped hardware auto-detection with the manual strip fallback control.
- Disabled white-channel contribution unless the effective strip is SK6812 RGBW or RGBWW.

releases.name: v0.14.2
releases.notes:
- Fixed open hardware-ID inputs being misread after ADC mode disabled the internal pull-up.
- Open legacy harnesses are now resolved digitally before resistor-divider ADC measurement, reliably selecting WS2812B with 27 LEDs.

releases.name: v0.14.1
releases.notes:
- Enabled internal pull-ups on both hardware-ID ADC inputs so an open legacy harness deterministically selects WS2812B with 27 LEDs.
- Retained external 10 kÎ© pull-ups as the recommended production implementation.

releases.name: v0.14.0
releases.notes:
- Added boot-time resistor identification for WS2812B, SK6812 RGBW/RGBWW, and APA102/SK9822 strips.
- Added a compact clocked APA102/SK9822 renderer using GPIO4 data and GPIO5 clock.
- Added automatic detection with a saved manual override and ID-voltage diagnostics in the web UI.
- Added independent resistor detection for the three supported assemblies: 6 LEDs at 30 LEDs/m, 11 LEDs at 60 LEDs/m, and 27 LEDs at 144 LEDs/m.

releases.name: v0.13.0
releases.notes:
- Added selectable WS2812B RGB, SK6812 RGBW, and SK6812 RGBWW strip presets.
- Added configurable extraction of the common RGB component into the SK6812 white channel.
- Kept WS2812B RGB as the default and required a power cycle only when the pixel format changes.

releases.name: v0.12.0
releases.notes:
- Made the startup fade color independently configurable, retaining Prusa orange as the default.
- Added stable and beta automatic-update channels; beta is the default for new installations.
- Labeled prerelease and stable builds in the Firmware page.
- Changed tagged GitHub builds to publish as prereleases until explicitly promoted to stable quality.

releases.name: v0.9.0
releases.notes:
- Added a non-persistent demo showcase on the Status page that cycles through all printer-state, progress, thermal, motion, and setup-AP lighting sequences.
- Kept PrusaLink polling active during demonstrations and restored live printer rendering immediately when demo mode stops.
- Mirrored the active demonstration and sequence name in the Status-page lightbar simulation.

releases.name: v0.8.2
releases.notes:
- Replaced generic semantic-version scanning and firmware asset ID formatting with small dedicated parsers.
- Simplified serial diagnostics and removed `printf`-style formatting from application code.
- Reduced the embedded web UI from 18,009 bytes to a 6,707-byte gzip asset while retaining an editable HTML source file.

releases.name: v0.8.1
releases.notes:
- Made release discovery and downloads anonymous now that the repository is public.
- Removed GitHub token storage and configuration from NVS and the web UI.

releases.name: v0.8.0
releases.notes:
- Added a persisted drag-and-drop priority list for printer and activity lighting effects.
- Added private GitHub release discovery using a write-only fine-grained token.
- Added one-click release installation and opt-in automatic update checks every six hours.
- Added a tag-triggered GitHub Actions release workflow that publishes the installable ESP32-C3 application binary.
